positioning.label: Positioning
headline: One creator.
Six industries. One standard.
paragraphs: Travel is the stage. Stories are the product. This studio works across travel, aviation, hospitality, technology, travel gear and lifestyle — with aviation as a genuine specialty, not the definition of everything else.

The same production discipline applies regardless of category: one person, shooting and editing every frame, holding a single editorial standard from an airline cabin to a homestay veranda to a product in hand.

about.label: About Karthik
headline: Karthik Thiramdas.
Hyderabad, India.
paragraphs: A traveller and filmmaker — no crew, no agency, no team standing off-camera. Every deliverable on this page was shot, edited, color graded and written by one person.
Full background, philosophy and process live on the Studio page — this page exists for the business case.
